lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 visible high-contrast vertical white lines. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso, with slightly higher density and narrower intervals observed in the posterior third of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed at the dorsal termination of the second and third posterior-most lines. A spatial merging of line segments is visible at the mid-dorsal origin of the 4th and 5th lines from the anterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most anterior line is abbreviated, terminating in the upper third of the torso. The three most posterior lines exhibit significant discontinuity, fragmenting into discrete spots at their ventral and dorsal extremities.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5-7 distinct high-contrast spots is located on the posterior lateral haunch, superior to the popliteal region. Spot density is highest in the area immediately posterior to the final vertical line.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A sequence of four spots on the upper posterior hind limb aligns to form a semi-connected diagonal geometric line extending toward the hock.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white transverse band across the lower neck/brisket; distinct white patches visible on the medial surfaces of the limbs; dark dorsal mane/fringe extending along the spine.
